facts.text: Caroline has a collection of children's books including classics, stories from different cultures, and educational books.

evidence.quote: I've got lots of kids' books- classics, stories from different cultures, educational books, all of that.

facts.text: Melanie recalls that 'Charlotte's Web' was a favorite childhood book because it illustrated the importance of friendship and compassion.

evidence.quote: I loved reading 'Charlotte's Web' as a kid. It was so cool seeing how friendship and compassion can make a difference.

facts.text: Caroline mentions that her friends and family have been supportive during her transition, and they recently had a picnic together.

evidence.quote: They make all the difference. We even had a picnic last week!

facts.text: Caroline expresses gratitude for her support network, stating that they have provided her with love, guidance, and acceptance throughout her transition.

evidence.quote: This support network has been amazing. They've been there for me every step of the way giving me love, guidance, and acceptance.
